parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security report.
You can call [DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~) to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
安全报告ID。
您可以调用[DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~)获取该值
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the export. Valid values:

HTML
PDF

Default value: HTML. PDF is supported only for security reports of version 2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
要导出的类型。取值：

HTML
PDF

默认值HTML，PDF仅2.0.0版本安全报告支持
parameters.name: export_type

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource directory.
You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the report

ExportDate.description_en: The time when the report was generated. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
ExportDate.description_zh: 报告生成时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD

ExportId.description_en: The ID of the export report task

ExportStatus.description_en:
The status of the export node. Valid values:
fail: The export failed.
exporting: The export is in progress.
success: The export succeeded
ExportStatus.description_zh:
导出任务的状态。取值：
fail：导出失败
exporting：导出中
success：导出成功

FileName.description_en: The name of the exported file

ReportId.description_en: The ID of the security report

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UrlExpiredTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the report download URL expires. Unit: seconds
UrlExpiredTime.description_zh: 报告下载链接过期时间戳。单位：秒
